title: Minimalist header — three different ways to read it

steps.headline: Which direction makes the controls visible and still feels like this theme?
steps.notice: These are distinct visual prototypes in the real renderer, not three strengths of one panel. Nothing has been made the default. Try both Meadow Mist and Midnight; 'None of these' is valid.

variants.label: Wallpaper-aware ink
variants.summary: Keep clear controls. Lighten the icons and each status color over Meadow Mist's blue header; leave Midnight's already-legible colors alone. The selected session gets a small dark patch behind its name.
variants.risk: This prototype samples one header area. A real implementation would need to follow wallpapers, window sizes and theme changes; these colors are not yet adaptive at runtime.

variants.label: Icon spotlights
variants.summary: Small backlit patches sit behind individual icons rather than filling whole buttons. The longer toggle and session switcher get their own readable glass backing.
variants.risk: The Session Files badge needs special positioning; the small patches may feel busy when many buttons sit together.

variants.label: Raised keys
variants.summary: Separate, flatter-edged controls use stronger local surfaces and a short bottom shadow—more like individual keys emerging from the wallpaper.
variants.risk: The shape is a bigger departure from the originally soft, melted-glass look.
